name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　タママロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Tamama Robo

description.ja: プレイバリュー満点のメカVer.に“タママロボ”発進！
description.en: “Tama Robo” launches in a mecha version with full play value!

description.ja: ランナーから切り離しただけで手足が可動する約45mmのタママ二等兵が付属。
description.en: Approximately 45mm Tamama private whose limbs can be moved just by separating it from the Runner is included.

description.ja: タママ二等兵は専用ソーサーに搭乗、そのまま飾れる専用台が付属。
description.en: Private Tamama rides on a special saucer, and comes with a special stand that can be displayed as is.

description.ja: ミサイルポッドは差し替え式で発射状態を再現。
description.en: The missile pod is replaceable and reproduces the firing state.
